title: FiniteLines coordinates for smooth purity
statement: Use [def-pur-transport-finite-encoding], [def-pur-transport-root-coordinates], [det-sp-finite-general-ring]. For a finite coefficient ring $A$ killed by $\ell^{n+1}$, use its universe lift with the same annihilator. Finite line coordinates identify the scalar extension of the integral root-tower line with the sectionwise encoding of the existing Cartier finite Tate line at that positive level. The map is fixed by precomposition with the scalar unit: it equals the integral tower projection followed by the free-module map on the identical root sections. The coefficient-unit comparison is fixed on each sheafification generator by the identical constant section. Thus both the line and the unit are normalized, without choosing a basis of roots.
